entries.preferred: Cap at 12 months of fees; super-cap at 3x (or uncapped) for IP infringement and data breach; exclude indirect/consequential damages both ways.
entries.fallback: Cap up to 24 months of fees above $250K ACV; super-cap 2x for data.
entries.walkAway: Cap below 12 months of fees, or uncapped indirect damages running to you.

entries.preferred: Mutual and capped; explicit third-party IP-infringement carve-out.
entries.fallback: Cap tied to 12-24 months of fees; exclude indirect damages.
entries.walkAway: One-directional indemnity without an IP carve-out.

entries.preferred: DPA with SCCs/IDTA as needed; 72-hour breach notification; audit rights and subprocessor controls.
entries.fallback: Defined breach windows and subprocessor controls.
entries.walkAway: No breach-notification obligation or no DPA.

entries.preferred: Termination for cause with a cure period; termination for convenience with notice.
entries.fallback: 30-60 day notice for material uncured breach.
entries.walkAway: No termination rights, or termination-for-convenience only for the counterparty.

entries.preferred: Mutual confidentiality surviving 3 years post-termination, with defined remedies.
entries.fallback: Mutual confidentiality with a defined survival period.
entries.walkAway: One-sided or unlimited-duration confidentiality obligations running to you.

entries.preferred: 99.9%+ uptime with meaningful, uncapped service credits.
entries.walkAway: No uptime commitment or no remedy for downtime.
